{{Quote|Nenn is the senior Master of the Theran Listeners&mdash;as close as we have to a leader.|[[Taru Durn]]|<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Conviction">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Conviction]]''</ref>}}
'''Nenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Oldtimer]] and senior [[Master of the Theran Listeners]]. He was taken by [[Abeloth]] and used as a way to turn the Oldtimers and the [[Theran Listener]]s against the Skywalkers and Khai who pursued her. When Skywalker cut Callista's personality out of Abeloth, Nenn was strong enough to take a lightsaber and kill himself, further weakening Abeloth and stopping the Theran Listeners from following her and freeing the Horn siblings from her grasp.
